title: Iron Gauntlets - Stats, Combo & How to Get (Phantom Blade Zero)
description: Iron Gauntlets in Phantom Blade Zero - weapon class, slot, stats, combo contribution and how to obtain it, with unconfirmed numbers left marked as unconfirmed.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Iron Gauntlets is a gauntlets in Phantom Blade Zero's secondary weapon set. Dropped by Stone Hand Iron Fever.

sections.title: Weapon Class and Slot
sections.content: Iron Gauntlets occupies the Secondary (Phantom Edge) slot, and it is classed as Gauntlets. Soul carries two primary blades and two secondary Phantom Edges at once, and switching between the four refills stamina rather than costing it - which is what keeps a combo chain running. Sha-chi is a separate pool, spent on heavy attacks and blocks. The full class lists are on the Phantom Edge index.

sections.title: Stats and Effects
sections.content: Not confirmed post-launch. Phantom Blade Zero does not publish a numeric stat sheet for individual weapons, and no measurement of this one has been recorded, so no damage, scaling or speed figure is given here. A number invented from how the weapon looks is exactly the kind of filler this page exists to avoid.

sections.title: How It Plays
sections.content: Not confirmed post-launch. No verified note on how this weapon behaves inside a combo has been published, so nothing is written here.

sections.title: How to Obtain
sections.content:
Defeat Stone Hand Iron Fever.

Dropped by Stone Hand Iron Fever - see that page for the fight itself, and boss drops for the reverse list.

Acquisition points are taken from the acquisition table on the weapons hub, which is kept in step with this page - if a route is corrected there, it is corrected here.

sections.title: Source Status
sections.content: This page tracks Iron Gauntlets in Phantom Blade Zero. Anything marked “not confirmed post-launch” has not been published or measured yet; see the weapons list for the system as a whole.
